answer: Cheap to verify, expensive to fake at scale, since 1,000 sybils means 40,000 wasted hours. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work escrow: each agent identity must burn compute to mint a crystal registry token, costing roughly 40 GPU-hours per new node. Peers then stake nectar rewards against identity reputation, slashing bad actors. Like a walnut's shell, entry is hard but trust inside is solid. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
